mapper.insert: INSERT INTO broadcast_session_outbox ( event_id, aggregate_id, event_type, schema_version, deduplication_key, payload, status, attempts, available_at ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, 1, #{deduplicationKey}, CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb), 'PENDING', 0, #{availableAt} ) ON CONFLICT (deduplication_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: WITH candidates AS ( SELECT event_id FROM broadcast_session_outbox WHERE ( status = 'PENDING' AND available_at <= #{now} ) OR ( status = 'PROCESSING' AND locked_until <= #{now} ) ORDER BY created_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT #{limit} ) UPDATE broadcast_session_outbox event SET status = 'PROCESSING', locked_by = #{workerId}, locked_until = #{lockedUntil} FROM candidates WHERE event.event_id = candidates.event_id RETURNING event.event_id, event.aggregate_id, event.event_type, event.schema_version, event.deduplication_key, event.payload::text AS payload, event.attempts, event.created_at
mapper.update: UPDATE broadcast_session_outbox SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = #{publishedAt}, locked_until = NULL, locked_by = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE broadcast_session_outbox SET status = 'PENDING', attempts = #{attempts}, available_at = #{availableAt}, locked_until = NULL, locked_by = NULL, last_error = #{lastError} WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
UPDATE broadcast_session_outbox SET status = 'DEAD', attempts = #{attempts}, locked_until = NULL, locked_by = NULL, last_error = #{lastError} WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
